verdict.rationale: Elastic's docs say telemetry can be queried ad hoc with ES|QL or PromQL. ES|QL has its own documented REST API covering output formats, timezone, locale, and Query DSL filters, and ES|QL is cited for sub-second queries over millions of metric time series. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ad-hoc ES|QL/PromQL analysis.

support.subject: As a developer, I can analyze telemetry ad hoc with a documented query language
